# Open

# Sentence

A short line about it.

# Paragraph

A paragraph about it, with a few more words in it than the sentence has.

# Short

Three paragraphs, one after the other, each of them saying the same thing in
a little more detail than the one before.

# Medium

A page of the same idea, written out at length, so that a reader who wants
the whole of it has it in front of them.

# Long

Three pages of the same idea, written out at length, so that a reader who
wants the whole of it has it in front of them and can go on reading.
